validation_notes: From late June through late July, VET has been trading in a tight, roughly flat sideways range between ~0.0045 and ~0.0050 with no clear convergence — highs and lows are both roughly flat, not narrowing. This looks more like a flat consolidation/rectangle than a descending triangle, since a descending triangle requires a clearly falling upper trendline (lower highs) with a flat support. Here the upper boundary is not making distinct lower highs; both boundaries appear flat. There's no visible apex forming near the right edge. I disagree with the algorithm's descending triangle call — the recent price action looks like range-bound consolidation after the prior steep downtrend from May, not an active converging triangle.
